summary: Iteration 67 - Microsoft SSO Integration Testing Complete. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All SSO features verified working correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'Failed to fetch settings' appears briefly during page load - cosmetic only, settings load correctly after

context_for_next_testing_agent: Microsoft SSO integration complete and tested. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/settings/microsoft-sso/status returns {enabled: false} when not configured, 2) GET /api/settings/microsoft-sso (authenticated) returns SSO config with defaults, 3) PUT /api/settings/microsoft-sso saves config (admin only), 4) Client secret is masked (********) on GET, 5) SSO status returns {enabled: true} when configured, 6) GET /api/auth/microsoft/login returns 400 when SSO disabled, 7) GET /api/auth/microsoft/login redirects to Microsoft when enabled, 8) Auth callback page at /auth/callback loads correctly, 9) Login page shows/hides 'Sign in with Microsoft' button based on SSO status, 10) Settings page has full SSO config section with all fields, 11) Standard login still works, 12) loginWithToken function exists in AuthProvider (App.js line 94-108).

sso_status_endpoint_disabled.details: GET /api/settings/microsoft-sso/status returns {enabled: false} when not configured

sso_settings_get_authenticated.details: GET /api/settings/microsoft-sso requires auth and returns config with defaults (enabled, tenant_id, client_id, auto_create_users, default_role)

sso_settings_put_admin_only.details: PUT /api/settings/microsoft-sso saves SSO configuration and returns success message

client_secret_masked.details: Client secret is masked as '********' when fetching SSO settings

sso_status_enabled_when_configured.details: GET /api/settings/microsoft-sso/status returns {enabled: true} when tenant_id, client_id set and enabled=true

microsoft_login_400_when_disabled.details: GET /api/auth/microsoft/login returns 400 when SSO not configured

microsoft_login_redirects_when_enabled.details: GET /api/auth/microsoft/login returns 302 redirect to login.microsoftonline.com with tenant_id and client_id in URL

auth_callback_page_loads.details: Auth callback page at /auth/callback route loads correctly, shows error state when no token provided

login_page_sso_button_visibility.details: Login page hides 'Sign in with Microsoft' button when SSO disabled, shows it when SSO enabled

settings_page_sso_section.details: Settings page has Microsoft SSO configuration section with all fields: sso-enabled-switch, sso-tenant-id, sso-client-id, sso-client-secret, sso-redirect-uri, sso-auto-create-switch, sso-default-role, save-sso-btn

standard_login_works.details: Standard login with email/password (aaron@stech.com.au / admin123) still works correctly

loginWithToken_function_exists.details: loginWithToken function exists in AuthProvider (App.js lines 94-108), stores token, fetches user via /api/auth/me

mocked_apis.note: Microsoft OAuth2 endpoints (login.microsoftonline.com, graph.microsoft.com) are external - cannot test actual SSO flow without real Azure credentials. Tested the plumbing: redirect URLs, config endpoints, button visibility.
